summary: Form 8-K filed by ConnectOne Bancorp, Inc. solely to announce a press release regarding the scheduling of its 2026 second quarter earnings release and conference call on July 23, 2026. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is involved. The filing is a routine current report providing notice of upcoming earnings results and a conference call with management. Therefore, this event does not fall under any defined special-situations category.
